AdoptionFinding.description: One observation of the preflight. A blocking finding stops the handoff.
AdoptionFinding.title: AdoptionFinding

AdoptionFindingKind.description: What an adoption preflight found. Each one is a decision the operator has to take.
AdoptionFindingKind.title: AdoptionFindingKind

AdoptionHandoff.description: What the handoff costs and what the operator does first. The hub rewrites no Compose file.
AdoptionHandoff.title: AdoptionHandoff

ApiUse.description: The model calls the API usage source paid for, priced where the model is known.
ApiUse.title: ApiUse

Avatar.description: How a client draws an instance. The hub keeps it, not the instance directory.
Avatar.title: Avatar

AvatarColor.description: A name from a fixed palette. A client maps each name to colors of its own theme.
AvatarColor.title: AvatarColor

Capability.description: What an instance's contract server can do. A hub reads it before acting on the instance.
Capability.title: Capability

ContainerOwner.description: Who manages an existing container now, read from the labels it carries.
ContainerOwner.title: ContainerOwner

DelegatedRun.description:
One run of an outside agent that a tool started, with that run's own tokens.

A client that reports a running total across resumes, like a Codex thread, needs its
previous reading subtracted. Only a limited run has ``resets_at``: when its plan window resets.
DelegatedRun.title: DelegatedRun

DrainState.description: How an instance's accepted work ended when it drained.
DrainState.title: DrainState

ErrorFrame.description: A frame the server could not read carries no id.
ErrorFrame.title: ErrorFrame

ImagePrepareCommand.description: Prepare a package selection's image. No package prepares kinby's base image.
ImagePrepareCommand.title: ImagePrepareCommand

InstanceAdoptCommand.description: Take ownership. The preflight runs again here, and a blocking finding stops it.
InstanceAdoptCommand.title: InstanceAdoptCommand

InstanceAdoptPreviewCommand.description: Preview an adoption. It reads the instance and its container and changes neither.
InstanceAdoptPreviewCommand.title: InstanceAdoptPreviewCommand

InstanceAdoptPreviewResult.description: What the hub would take over, and what stands in the way of taking it.
InstanceAdoptPreviewResult.title: InstanceAdoptPreviewResult

InstanceDeleteCommand.description: Delete the previewed targets. A target that changed since the preview stops it.
InstanceDeleteCommand.title: InstanceDeleteCommand

InstanceDeletePreviewCommand.description: Preview a removed instance's permanent deletion. It reads the retained inventory only.
InstanceDeletePreviewCommand.title: InstanceDeletePreviewCommand

InstanceDeletePreviewResult.description: Exactly what a deletion removes: the removed instance's owned directories and volumes.
InstanceDeletePreviewResult.title: InstanceDeletePreviewResult

InstanceRemoveCommand.description: Drain and remove one instance's container. Its data and its record stay behind.
InstanceRemoveCommand.title: InstanceRemoveCommand

InstanceRestoreCommand.description: Bring a removed instance back from its retained record, stopped.
InstanceRestoreCommand.title: InstanceRestoreCommand

InstanceSecretsSetCommand.description: Replace the named values in one instance's secrets. The result carries none of them back.
InstanceSecretsSetCommand.title: InstanceSecretsSetCommand

InstanceUpdateCommand.description:
Move one instance to the image a revision prepares.

Its package selection travels along, moved to another commit when a pin names one.
InstanceUpdateCommand.title: InstanceUpdateCommand

OperationStep.description: One named stage of a lifecycle operation, in the order the hub ran it.
OperationStep.title: OperationStep

PackageCommit.description: One commit of a package's git repository, installed in place of an index version.
PackageCommit.title: PackageCommit

PackageDescribeCommand.description: Read what a prepared selection declares. It never builds.
PackageDescribeCommand.title: PackageDescribeCommand

PackageDescription.description:
What a prepared image declares: its card, its version, and its setup fields.

The built-in fields come first, then the package's own.
PackageDescription.title: PackageDescription

PackagePin.description:
Move an instance's package to another commit of the git repository it comes from.

It names the package it moves, which must be the instance's own (ADR 0040).
PackagePin.title: PackagePin

PlanLimit.description: A subscription usage source whose plan stopped a delegated run, until its window resets.
PlanLimit.title: PlanLimit

PlanWindow.description: A rolling period over which a subscription usage source limits use.
PlanWindow.title: PlanWindow

ReportedRun.description: A delegated run and the time it was recorded, which places it in a time range.
ReportedRun.title: ReportedRun

SetupField.description: One value a prepared image asks for before an instance is created from it.
SetupField.title: SetupField

SetupFieldKind.description: Where a setup field's value lands: the instance's configuration, or its secrets.
SetupFieldKind.title: SetupFieldKind

SetupFieldType.description: How a client asks for a setup field's value.
SetupFieldType.title: SetupFieldType

StatsSummaryResult.description:
Usage across the hub's running instances, read live from each one and stored nowhere.

A total leaves out every instance in ``skipped`` or ``unreachable``.
StatsSummaryResult.title: StatsSummaryResult

SubscriptionUse.description: The delegated runs one subscription usage source paid for, counted and never priced.
SubscriptionUse.title: SubscriptionUse

TurnTarget.description: One turn or workspace revert that a workspace operation can target.
TurnTarget.title: TurnTarget

WorkspaceReverted.description: The workspace went from ``previous`` back to ``restored``, the target's before tree.
WorkspaceReverted.title: WorkspaceReverted
